relevance_note: Case series of two children with GFAP variants and Alexander disease: 'targeted molecular testing revealed a mutation in Exon 1 of the GFAP gene (R79C)' (Case 1) and 'an R416 W mutation in GFAP' (Case 2).
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON. Two in-scope people (Case 1, Case 2); no relatives described (Case 1 adopted; Case 2's cousin with multiple sclerosis is not in scope). Variants are printed only in one-letter protein form ('R79C', 'R416 W' with a space as printed); recorded as protein strings, no cDNA or transcript printed; zygosity, inheritance and class not stated for either person. Tables 1 and 2 hold neuropsychological test scores (patients as single subjects, columns are evaluation ages); scores were not transcribed as features beyond the text's own summaries; '–' cells are undefined and unused. No stacked cells. is_proband left null: the paper does not call either case proband/index and it is a two-case series. Age at diagnosis left not reported for both: not stated directly (Case 2's '14 years of age (2 years post-diagnosis)' implies 12, not used). Case 1 last evaluation taken as 'at age 12' (paper's 'last assessment'), though a later MRI at age 13 is reported. Possible contradiction: Figure 1 caption says the MRI of case 2 was 'at age 10', while the text gives the first brain MRI at 12 years of age. Case 2 '6 months post-baseline ... not suggestive of any cognitive decline' but later decline in FSIQ (78 to 60); checklist cognitive decline set observed (later time point). Case 2 'motor and speech milestones within normal limits' recorded as excluded feature, but checklist developmental delay left not reported (narrower than the broad item). Case 2 'poor balance' not mapped to ataxia; Case 1 'choke on foods' not mapped to dysphagia; ventriculomegaly not mapped to hydrocephalus; 'potential progressive aqueductal stenosis' is hedged and not recorded. Prior report: the paper says Case 1's MRI images are presented in Matarese & Renaud (2008), recorded as a prior report.
